sections.heading: Core skills
sections.text:
Core Passive Temporal Patterns = Stilled Colors

 Lv. 1

 Remielle's [Refringe Coefficient] is equal to 0.02% of her Anomaly Proficiency. If there are 3 [Anomaly] characters in the squad, her [Refringe Coefficient] increases by an additional 10% .
 When Remielle triggers a Refringe reaction via a squad member, she generates [Voidflare] based on the Anomaly Effect Strength after it has been enhanced by [Refringe] from the Attribute Anomaly effect. Up to the 3 most recently generated [Voidflare] can be stored.
 If [Assist: Flower & Feather Dance]/[Ultimate: Dazzling Curtain Call]/[Basic Attack: Rainbow's End]/[Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace] hits a target, [Luminize] is triggered after the skill ends:
 Based on the total [Anomaly Effect Strength] of all stored [Voidflare], this deals Attribute Anomaly DMG to the enemy using the corresponding skill's DMG multiplier. This multiplier is further increased by 0.1% of Remielle's Anomaly Proficiency.

 All stored [Voidflare] are cleared when Remielle enters the Phase Flow state or after using [Basic Attack: Rainbow's End] or [Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace].

 BASE ATK : 0

 Additional Ability Invitation to Bloom

 When another character in your squad is an [Anomaly] character or shares the same faction:
 When there are 1/2/3 [Anomaly] characters in the squad, upon entering the battlefield, all squad members gain an ATK increase equal to 6%/12%/40% of Remielle's initial ATK, up to a maximum of 1,600 ATK. Additionally, while in the Phase Flow state, Remielle's Daze dealt increases by 6%/12%/35% .
 When Remielle applies [Lumiflux Buildup] to an enemy, they also inflict [Prismatic]: When all squad members attack an enemy affected by [Prismatic], Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 15% . [Prismatic] is removed when the enemy no longer has [Lumiflux Buildup]. After [Prismatic] is removed, the Anomaly Buildup Rate increase persists for an additional 8s .

sections.heading: Skills
sections.text:
Basic
 Dodge
 Assist
 Special
 Chain

 Basic Attack: Leap

 Press to activate:
Perform up to four attacks ahead, dealing Lumiflux DMG.
If the Basic Attack hits the target, gain Floating Radiance after the skill ends.
After the 4th hit of the Basic Attack ends, 1 Lumiflux Buildup is applied to enemies hit.
 Multipliers

 Basic Attack: Solo Dance

 Hold to activate:
Perform a slash in an area ahead, dealing Lumiflux DMG.
If it hits a target, gain Floating Radiance after the skill ends.
 Multipliers

 Basic Attack: Rainbow's End

 When Remielle has Voidflare, hold to activate:
Unleash a powerful large area attack ahead, dealing Lumiflux DMG.
Grants a large amount of [Floating Radiance] when the skill ends.
If the attack hits a target, triggers the Luminize effect after the skill ends with a X% multiplier.
Consumes all stored [Voidflare] upon use.
 Multipliers

 Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace

 When Remielle has stored Voidflare and is in the Luminous Reflection state, hold to activate:
Unleash a powerful large area attack ahead, dealing Lumiflux DMG.
Grants a large amount of Floating Radiance when the skill ends.
If the attack hits a target, it triggers the Luminize effect after the skill ends with a multiplier of X%.
Consumes all stored Voidflare upon use.
 Multipliers

 Dodge: Retreating Light

 Press to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

 Dash Attack: Keen Light

 Press during a dodge to activate:
Launch a quick attack ahead, dealing Lumiflux DMG.
 Multipliers

 Dodge Counter: Mirrored Shadow

 Press during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Unleash a powerful slash at the target, dealing Lumiflux DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
 Multipliers

 Special Attack: Sliver of Light

 Press to activate:
Launch a ranged attack ahead, dealing Lumiflux DMG.
 Multipliers

 EX Special Attack: Ode to Dawn

 Upon entering the battlefield, if the character has less than 60 Energy, recover Energy to 60. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s;
With enough Energy, press to activate:
Unleash a powerful attack across a large area ahead, dealing Lumiflux DMG;
After the skill ends, apply 2 [Lumiflux Buildup] to all enemies hit;
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
 Multipliers

 Special Attack: Ode to Dawn - Radiant Turn

 When Remielle is in-combat and [Floating Radiance] reaches its maximum of 120, hold after a [Special Attack] or [EX Special Attack] to enter [Stance Shift]. Switching Characters while in [Stance Shift] enters the [Phase Flow] state:
While in the [Phase Flow] state, Remielle acts autonomously to assist in combat. Some attacks also apply [Lumiflux Buildup] to the target. [Floating Radiance] is consumed over time while in the [Phase Flow] state. When [Floating Radiance] is depleted or Remielle leaves the in-combat state, she exits the [Phase Flow] state. Before exiting the [Phase Flow] state, Remielle cannot be switched in except via a [Chain Attack];
If Remielle triggers 3 Refringe reactions while in the [Phase Flow] state, or has at least 1 stored Voidflare when [Floating Radiance] is depleted, [Assist: Flower & Feather Dance] is activated, unlocking normal switch-ins and automatically triggering [Assist: Flower & Feather Dance] on Remielle's next normal switch-in;
Upon entering the [Phase Flow] state, all squad members' DMG dealt is increased by X% for 60s. Repeated triggers reset the duration;
If Remielle uses a [Special Attack] or [EX Special Attack] that hits a Stunned enemy and [Floating Radiance] has reached its maximum of 120, switching Characters during the [Special Attack] or [EX Special Attack] also enters the [Phase Flow] state;
If no character is switched in after entering [Stance Shift], Remielle uses a downward attack to return to the ground.
 Multipliers

 Chain Attack: Interwoven Dance Steps

 When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launch multiple attacks ahead in a large area, dealing Lumiflux DMG.
Enter the Luminous Reflection state upon activation. The next Basic Attack: Rainbow's End is upgraded to Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace.
After the skill ends, apply 2 Lumiflux Buildup to enemies hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
 Multipliers

 Ultimate: Dazzling Curtain Call

 When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate:
Launch a attack across a large area in front, dealing Lumiflux DMG.
If the skill hits, the Luminize effect can be triggered after the skill ends with a multiplier of X%.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
 Multipliers

 Quick Assist: Featherglow Rebirth

 When the active character is launched, press to activate:
Unleash a slash at the target, dealing Lumiflux DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
 Multipliers

 Defensive Assist: Fleeting Light

 When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
 Multipliers

 Assist Follow-Up: Awakening Glimmer

 Press after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Unleashes a series of slashes against the target, dealing Lumiflux DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
 Multipliers

sections.heading: Mindscapes
sections.text:
M1
 Naive Oath
 Mindscape 1

 Upon entering the battlefield, Remielle gains 3 special Voidflare. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s . When Remielle triggers Luminize to deal DMG, she ignores 50% of the target's All-Attribute RES.
 When using [Assist: Flower & Feather Dance], she gains 200 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 18s . While Remielle is in the Phase Flow state, other squad members' Attribute Anomaly DMG increases by 10% .

 M2
 Fall Into the Noise
 Mindscape 2

 Remielle's [Refringe Coefficient] increases by 20% . When an [Anomaly] character in the squad deals Attribute Anomaly DMG to an enemy affected by [Prismatic], the attack ignores 15% of the target's DEF. This effect persists for an additional 8s after [Prismatic] ends. While Remielle is in the Phase Flow state, the frequency at which she automatically launches attacks to apply [Lumiflux Buildup] to enemies increases.

 M3
 The Garden of Diverging Time
 Mindscape 3

 Basic Attack, Assist, Dodge, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

 M4
 The Long Goodbye
 Mindscape 4

 When Remielle triggers Luminize, the DMG multiplier is increased by an additional 12% . After Remielle enters the battlefield and gains 3 special Voidflare, if all [Voidflare] are consumed, she immediately gains the maximum number of special [Voidflare] again. This effect is removed after triggering once or when Remielle enters the Phase Flow state.

 M5
 To Drink Forgetfulness
 Mindscape 5

 Basic Attack, Assist, Dodge, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

 M6
 Lone Feather's Endless Flight
 Mindscape 6

 When Remielle uses [Basic Attack: Rainbow's End] or [Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace], Luminize is triggered twice. If the 4th hit of her [Basic Attack] lands, Remielle gains 3 special Voidflare after the move ends. Special [Voidflare] gained this way deal DMG equal to 25% of the special [Voidflare] gained upon entering the battlefield.
